tells.1: The repeated bold claim followed by an explanatory restatement makes the rationale feel templated.
tells.2: Several topic sentences repeat what the following sentences explain, giving otherwise natural prose a formulaic rhythm.
tells.3: The repeated 'Mitigation:' labels are mechanical, though useful for scanning.
tells.4: Repeated 'We will' sentences and vague simplifications such as 'cost a lot' make the editing feel mechanical.

reason: Version 3 is the leanest while preserving professional tone and appropriate uncertainty about returns. Version 4 loses precision and turns proposed mitigations into commitments; these are editorial judgments, not reliable evidence of AI authorship.
